create_default_sdpa: create a default SDPA instance with an attention bias and optional dropout and scale parameters
set_default_sdpa_factory: set a custom SDPAFactory as the default factory for creating scaled dot-product attention instances
get_default_sdpa_factory: get the current default SDPAFactory used for creating scaled dot-product attention instances
review_SDPAFactory_protocol: review the SDPAFactory protocol that defines the callable interface for constructing SDPA instances
refactor_sdpa_factory: refactor the default SDPA factory to use a custom implementation instead of TorchSDPA
